messages:
Maya (product): Kickoff  we need launch criteria for dedicated reserved pools: sizing, quota modes, burst windows, autoscale gating. Goals: predictable tail latency + customer-facing contract. Who can scope MVP?

Leon (eng): I can. Propose priorities: critical / standard / best-effort. Soft quota = token-bucket with a short grace; hard quota = immediate 429. Need clear eviction order.

Priya (eng-sre): Ops needs quick-evict, manual drain, and auto-fallback to a compatible hosted model/region. Monitor: p95/p99 latency, headroom_pct, preempt_rate/min, queue_depth.

Carlos (sales): Customers ask for simple SKU language: baseline reserved + explicit "best-effort burst" description. Need contract text examples for sales.

Mei (cs): Also want per-route overrides (protect chat, allow embeddings to be best-effort). UI should let CS set route priorities per-tenant.

Leon (eng): Implementation sketch: tag sessions with priority, maintain per-tenant token buckets, evict KV caches by priority then LRU. Soft mode refunds small tokens on short windows.

Maya (product): MVP checklist: API + console to set reserved size & per-route priority; soft quotas opt-in; tenant observability (headroom + preempt log); pilot canary; operator quick-evict.

Priya (eng-sre): Rollout mitigations: feature flags, per-tenant canary, automatic fallback, chaos test for preempt path. Have operator runbook ready before pilot.

Carlos (sales): I'll secure 2 pilots that accept soft quotas and gradual rollout. I'll also draft customer-facing FAQ clarifying "best-effort" behavior.

Maya (product): Actions: Leon -> spec PR + example payloads; Priya -> runbook + operator UI mock; Carlos -> pilots + SKUs; Mei -> CS onboarding playbook. Sync Thu 10am to review spec. Thanks.

deploy-bot: Reminder  any spec PR touching capacity must include migration notes and schema changes. Branch protection enabled when PR is opened.
